blocks.text: Following an earlier failed attempt to move the ark, David implements a carefully ordered correction. He assembles the priests and Levites to carry the ark precisely according to the prescribed ordinance, with the Levites appointed as God's chosen carriers. The ark is borne on their shoulders with the staves, exactly as Moses had commanded. By this proper procedure and the establishment of worship arrangements before the ark, David ensures that the transportation of the ark conforms to the requirements that had been violated in the initial procession.
